children: American Outdoor Brands reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 results with net sales of $37.3 million and a GAAP net loss of $1.5 million for the quarter ended July 31, 2026. Gross profit was $19.7 million representing a 53.0% gross margin, and non-GAAP diluted EPS was $0.03. The company reiterated full-year net sales guidance of $200 million to $210 million and raised Adjusted EBITDA guidance to $14.5 million–$17.5 million.
Net sales: $37.3 million for the quarter ended July 31, 2026 (vs. $29.7 million year-ago).
Gross profit: $19.7 million; gross margin: 53.0% (compared with 46.7% in prior-year quarter).
Operating loss: $(2.1) million for the quarter (GAAP operating loss disclosed).
GAAP net loss: $(1.5) million, or $(0.12) per diluted share.
Non-GAAP net income: $0.415 million, or $0.03 per diluted share; Non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA: $1.159 million (3.1% of net sales).
Reported quarterly net sales increased 25.4% year-over-year; adjusted for prior-year retailer order acceleration, sales increased ~4.3%.
Sales growth was broad-based across Outdoor Lifestyle and Shooting Sports categories, with positive point-of-sale momentum (POS +6% Outdoor Lifestyle; +3% Shooting Sports).
New products accounted for more than 36% of net sales; Caldwell ClayCopter platform and ClayCopter Surface-to-Air received industry recognition (Frank Desomma Innovation of the Year 2026).
BUBBA brand expanded with new product introductions including the Pro Series Gen 2 Electric Fillet Knife and launched SCORETRACKER LIVE digital platform in partnership with Major League Fishing.
Strong cash generation: ended the quarter with $33.3 million in cash and no debt, enhancing financial flexibility for investments and growth initiatives.
